source_documents.title: Photophysical properties of oligophenylenes end-capped with naphthyls in solution and solid state

reference_evidence_units.quote: Para-DNpOPhs exhibit high fluorescence quantum yields and enhanced radiative rates, kf whereas meta-analogues show blue-shifted spectra and reduced oscillator strengths due to localized frontier orbitals.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DNpOPhs

reference_evidence_units.quote: TD-DFT calculations reproduce the experimental trends, demonstrating a linear correlation between computed oscillator strengths, f and measured kf in solution, consistent with the Strickler–Berg relationship.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DNpOPhs
reference_evidence_units.statement: kf scales with the computed oscillator strength.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These characteristics suggest that the observed fluorescence arises from a locally excited p–p* state, rather than from excimer formation or intermolecular p–p* interactions between the phenylene backbone and the naphthyl groups.
reference_evidence_units.subject: para-DNpOPhs
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission is LE π-π*, not excimer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Because phosphorescence was observed from all DNpOPhs, the knr values is attributed primarily to intersystem crossing from the S1 state to the triplet state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DNpOPhs
reference_evidence_units.statement: knr is assigned mainly to ISC.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Room-temperature IC is not separated (the paper notes both may contribute).

reference_evidence_units.quote: This deviation from linearity suggests that radiative processes are no longer solely dictated by the transition dipole moment in the condensed phase.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DNpOPhs with large f
reference_evidence_units.statement: In the solid kf levels off (~5e8 s-1) for large f.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the meta-dinaphthylbenzenes (m-1PX, X = 1 and 2) display the UV absorption bands shifted to higher energies relative to their para-counterparts, consistent with the known blue-shift associated with interrupted p-conjugation in meta-linked oligophenylenes.
reference_evidence_units.subject: m-1P1 vs p-1P1

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The paper's explanation: substitution topology sets the oscillator strength and kf (Strickler-Berg correlation). Meta linkage gives localised orbitals, small f and kf 1.2e8 s-1 (Φf 0.24).

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF

mechanism_decisions.rationale: Excimer emission is excluded for the para series (E03), but solid-state kf saturation is put down to unspecified intermolecular interactions (E05); not labelled either way.

contrast_group.varied_factor: linkage of the central benzene (1,3 vs 1,4) between two 1-naphthyl groups
contrast_group.paper_difference: Meta linkage localises the frontier orbitals and lowers f and kf (1.2e8 vs 6.3e8 s-1), giving Φf 0.24 vs 0.63 in chloroform.
